law.name: frequency-domain correction
law.author: Hertzforge contributors
law.summary: Starts from the inverse of the identified plant applied to the reference pulse, then after each pulse corrects the drive spectrum by a fraction of the inverse times the error, on the bins the controller trusts. Each bin's growth is limited per pulse.

params.label: Correction gain
params.help: The fraction of each pulse's error corrected before the next pulse. 1 corrects the whole error at once; smaller values settle more gently when the plant estimate is uncertain.

params.label: Largest rise per pulse
params.help: The most any one frequency of the drive may grow from one pulse to the next. A frequency may always fall.

params.label: First pulse backoff
params.help: How far under the predicted drive the first pulse starts. The correction brings the level up over the next pulses.

diagnostics.label: Corrected bins
diagnostics.help: Bins whose drive the law moved on this call.

diagnostics.label: Bins at the rise limit
diagnostics.help: Bins whose rise the law held to its largest rise per pulse on this call.

diagnostics.label: Drive change
diagnostics.help: The drive's peak against the last drive's, in dB (0 at the seed).
